neighbours.label: a singular count noun with its article missing, as in non-native English ('is far more serious problem', 'is right option', 'came up with decent solution'); the same noun phrase with 'a' or 'the' stays quiet
fire: For many families, diabetes is much bigger worry than rent.
My cousin says that yoga is best way to relax after work.
We finally found cheap apartment near the station.
Rice is staple food that feeds half the planet.
The council is government body that manages the city's parks.
In my view, this laptop is excellent choice for students.
I wrote small script for renaming the photos.
Honesty is quality that every manager should value.
